name: remotion-skill-examples
description: Four finished compositions built with the remotion-motion-graphics skill

scripts.render:v3show: remotion render src/v3c/index.ts V3PortfolioARShow out/v3-portfolio-ar-show.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
